question: The novel 'Tamas' has been writtern by :
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhisham Sahani**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhisham Sahani** is the author of the novel 'Tamas'.
 
• 'Tamas' is a Hindi novel that depicts the horrors of the partition of India.
 
• Bhisham Sahani was an eminent Hindi writer, playwright, and actor, known for his contributions to Indian literature.
 
• The novel 'Tamas' won the Sahitya Akademi Award in 1975.
 
• It has been translated into several languages and adapted into a television series directed by Govind Nihalani.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bhisham Sahani was born on 8th August 1915 and passed away on 11th July 2003.
 
• He was a recipient of the Padma Bhushan in 1998 for his contribution to literature and arts.
 
• Besides 'Tamas', his other notable works include 'Madhavi', 'Basanti', and 'Katha-Ratnawali'.
 
• Sahani was also involved in the Indian People's Theatre Association (IPTA) and contributed significantly to Hindi theatre.
 
• His works often explore themes of social justice, human rights, and the plight of the common man.
